**Finding: compliant** (no redline needed).

The Article 5 grant in AbbVie's favour satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **Scope/exclusivity** — §5.1.3(a)–(b) grants an exclusive licence (including against Harpoon and its Affiliates) plus right of reference to Exploit the Licensed Compounds/Products in the Field in the Territory, automatically effective on the License Option Exercise Closing Date.
- **Affiliates and contractors** — §5.3 permits sublicensing through multiple tiers to "its Affiliates and other Persons"; §§5.4–5.5 confirm Affiliate/Third Party distribution and co-promotion at our sole discretion. No notice or consent gate, so this exceeds the fallback.
- **Not revocable at will** — no "revocable" language; termination is limited to the Article 12 grounds (including uncured material breach), and §12.1.2 makes the §5.1.3 grants non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and **irrevocable** on expiry of the Term.
- **Successor transfer** — §13.4.1 allows assignment without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, stock or asset sale, and binds Harpoon's successors to the grant.
- **Grant-back** — §5.2 to Harpoon is suitably narrow (non-exclusive, royalty-free, no sublicensing except permitted subcontractors, solely to perform the Initial Development Plan), so it does not erode our position.
